5289-7507-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5289-7507-7874-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1895-4399-4518-6458.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2079-2447-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4954-5234.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

Gorma triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

3490-5231-6097-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6097-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

57-3094-4846-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-4846-7175.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2024-2060-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler
Activate Crystalline Crawler five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{G}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Tromell and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

147-2292-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

4153-4785-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-4785-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

864-3821-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Eternal Witness and Peregrine Drake, targeting Eternal Witness
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Eternal Witness and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Huatli's Raptor dies, triggering Magnanimous Magistrate, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Huatli's Raptor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Huatli's Raptor enters the battlefield, causing you to proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

2249-4186-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

864-933-957.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
